decision_reason: F-0002 has the same expectation, observation, evidence, severity, causal hypothesis, and correction check as F-0001. It was introduced only to satisfy the state-machine route needed to record correcting-stage provenance and is therefore a duplicate rather than a second product deviation.

causal_assessment.hypothesis: The feedback is duplicate bookkeeping rather than an independent defect.
supporting_evidence: F-0001 and F-0002 describe the same timestamp, page, reproduction, cause, and correction check.
causal_assessment.falsifier: F-0002 reproduces on a different timestamp contract or has an independently actionable cause.

invariants: Do not count one observed deviation twice.
correction_check: Confirm F-0001 remains the single disclosed platform timestamp residual risk.
